claims.text: Introducing a nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation into the CoCrFeNi matrix will maintain low coefficient of friction and wear rate from room temperature to 800 °C.
The nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation will provide a self-lubricating effect.
The nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation will reduce contact stress.
The nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation will promote formation of a stable tribofilm.
Self-lubrication, reduced contact stress, and stable tribofilm formation will maintain low coefficient of friction and wear rate throughout the stated temperature range.
The modified CoCrFeNi matrix will have a lower coefficient of friction than the starting CoCrFeNi matrix.
The modified CoCrFeNi matrix will have a lower wear rate than the starting CoCrFeNi matrix.
The predicted reductions in coefficient of friction and wear rate will be particularly evident at high temperatures.
The proposed effect applies under dry sliding at moderate-to-high loads from room temperature to 800 °C.
